title: How would I trigger a common event when player health/mind stat drops below a certain number?

posts.author: GrimRose
posts.body:
I've just recently started on my first project in Rpg Maker Mv. I have two status bars for the player character. (health/hp and mind instead of mp)
If either Mind/Health drops to zero it will trigger a game over screen. I also wanted to have it where if the health/mind stat drops below a certain number it will have an effect on the player character. For example if the Max health/Mind is 20, the effect would only trigger if the character's health is below 5.
Spoiler:
Mind/Health Menu
I was trying to set up a common event that changes the player character sprite/face, plays certain bgs/bgm and adds filter effects over top the screen.
Spoiler:
Normal
Spoiler:
Low Mind Stat
I was wondering how I would get the common event to be triggered if the characters health/mind stat drop below 5 and have the common event end/not run if the characters health is above 5. Any suggestions/help would be greatly appreciated.

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
There are two ways to do this.
the complicated but better way and the easy but lag-prone way.
For the complicated way yoiu simply call a common event on everything that changes the player health after it has changed.
this is easy for battles (troop event condition actor health<5% then check the exact value), but you would have to add that call to every event on maps that does damage and to all heaking skills and so on. And it might still cause problems with damaging tiles as they don't have such triggers.
The easy way is to make a common event parallel process with a wait(5) and then check the current health the normal way (control variable and conditional branch).
The problem with this is that if your game uses too many parallel processes, it will cause lag.
You'll have to decide for yourself which way to go based on the rest of your game

there.
hook everything to the same common event that starts with the condition to check for sanity.
if sane, subtract.
if below threshold, handle.
